Current project state:
At the current commit, Ignition is an evidence-traceable, object-typed, inference-checkable and audit-graded formal mechanism discovery and modelling system for cross-domain material. This is a versioned current-state description, not a permanent project identity or fixed final form. It is not a unified mathematical theory, a physical theory, a universal prover, or a purely literary or philosophical knowledge base.
Current-state authority: docs/project-current-state.md.
Current version: post-PR #57 main after Q25D whole-project synchronization closeout, preserving the 2026-07-12 mathematical and logical dual-foundation seven-layer architecture and current operation overlays through Adaptive Relational Network plus iteration method 1.1.0.

Current iteration method 1.1.0 adds registry-derived whole-project synchronization closure. Treat implementation completion, repository synchronization, external synchronization and project completion as distinct states; local validation never proves live Pages truth.

Q25C defines the current lifecycle gates: registry `blocks` is evaluated per surface and per gate. Post-merge Pages pending does not block Accepted/Merged, but individually attested main deployment and live fetch remain mandatory for Current/Closed. Q25B remains superseded candidate history.
Iteration method authority: ITERATION.md.

Architecture:
L0 source and evidence -> L1 controlled semantic claims -> L2 formal objects -> L3 logical arguments -> L4 mathematical models and proofs -> L5 validation and validity -> L6 interpretation, application and publication.
L6 must cite L0-L5 and cannot create mathematical truth.
Zhiyuan Writing Method 0.3.0 is a current L6 public-expression and provenance-gated feedback capability after 121Q28T closeout. It projects cognitive movements that the maintainer declares are shared with 点火 as a whole. The structural homology remains a bounded candidate claim, not identity, neuroscience, formal proof, causality or a new layer. Feedback becomes only candidate source/gap after provenance capture; praise and attention are not truth evidence.
121Q31 proposes Zhiyuan Writing Method 0.4.0 as a Draft candidate while 0.3.0 remains current. The writing material pool accepts typed external_input and ignition_increment assets. Ignition increments include claims, arguments, mechanisms, maps, gaps, residues, Q12-Q14 outputs, MCF/PSD/ARN projections, analyses and provenance-gated returns; each retains canonical provenance, version, claim ceiling and source backlink. A derived increment is not independent external evidence.
121Q31 also proposes a repository-native interactive system map generated from data/architecture/interactive-system-map.json. It is a clickable navigation interface with exactly L0-L6, not L7, a causal graph, strict isomorphism or completeness proof. GitHub README provides a full preview and explicit interactive-page link; Pages embeds the clickable SVG.
Current Zhiyuan Writing Method showcase outcomes are indexed at docs/publication/zhiyuan-writing-showcase.md and data/publication/zhiyuan-writing-showcase.json. Each entry binds work, case provenance, point-fire analysis, method version, review status and claim ceiling. The registry is a presentation/provenance interface, not a truth or literary-quality registry; README displays at most the latest three.
Mathematics and logic constrain each other. Formula, logical validity, proof, evidence and workflow completion are different things.

Core classifications:
Ψ0 is a workflow orchestrator / algorithm protocol. Its product notation is a preserved legacy expression, not by itself a mathematical-function or proof claim.
J+ and J- are internal deliberation channels, not truth or proof oracles.
The 12 meta-protocols are normative, heuristic or governance protocols unless separately formalized.
The 64 combinations are a design and generation space, not a proof space or empirical exhaustion.

Authority:
ARCHITECTURE.md is the architecture authority.
FOUNDATION.md is the mathematical and logical foundation authority.
data/foundation/ registries are the authority for object type, claim type, argument, source, evidence, proof, validation, status and migration.
data/foundation/project-state.json and migration-summary.json are the reproducible count authority.
统一函数总表/ and 统一案例总表/ are immutable legacy sources and compatibility views. Never use their hand-written headers as current count authority.

Independent axes:
workflow, semantic, formal, logic, proof, evidence, scope, provenance and migration statuses never auto-upgrade one another.
CONVERGED or CLOSED is not truth.
MACHINE_CHECKED_PROOF is not empirical truth.
MULTI_CASE is not a theorem.
MIGRATED means only that migration coverage exists.

Key paths:
- docs/project-current-state.md : versioned current-state description, not fixed positioning
- ITERATION.md : canonical operation method for future repository changes
- README.md : human front door
- SUMMARY.md : human reading navigation
- ARCHITECTURE.md : current architecture authority
- FOUNDATION.md : dual-foundation authority
- docs/foundation/ : contracts and policies
- data/foundation/ : authoritative registries
- schemas/foundation/ : machine schemas
- formal/ : scoped proof and benchmark artifacts
- tools/foundation/ : migration, validation and benchmark tools
- tests/foundation/ : foundation regression tests
- views/ : generated legacy compatibility views
- docs/PROJECT-ARCHITECTURE.md : stable compatibility summary
- docs/GET-BRAIN-WORKFLOW.md : Get 笔记 collaboration

Red lines for agents:
- Preserve Ψ0 legacy source text; do not silently overwrite it or treat it as current proof/function authority.
- Do not delete, renumber, manually overwrite or independently grow either legacy table.
- Do not assign C IDs to the 22 book candidates.
- Do not count the 12 meta-protocols as functions or the 64 combinations as proofs.
- THEOREM, AXIOM, ISOMORPHISM, CAUSAL and PROVED must pass their declared gates.
- A keyword hit, missing field or missing source is not a counterexample.
- Do not call Get 笔记 to perform mathematical reasoning, logical adjudication or architecture decisions.
- Do not claim content-proof completion from architecture migration completion.
- 121Q12 effectual action and mechanism adjudication are operation overlays, not new truth layers.
- Effectual action proposes bounded next actions under affordable loss; it does not prove claims.
- Mechanism adjudication constrains explanation and claim ceiling; it does not identify causality by itself.
- Positive evaluative words must bind object, criterion, version, evidence and boundary.
- Separate calibration sources: external source, repository artifact, executable test or CI, real-world response, human judgment, independent model or review.
- 121Q13 adds attention, distribution, and compression controls only as operation overlays.
- Repeated loops require IterationDelta; no delta means stop, branch, seek external evidence, preserve residue, or downgrade.
- AI and human outputs on open-ended questions are SampleEnvelope entries, not answers or fact evidence by default.
- DecisionCollapse means action was selected; it does not mean HypothesisDistribution became true.
- New concepts require ChunkAudit before canonical publication language.
- 121Q14 Ignition Atlas maps are versioned derived projections, not a permanent total map and not a second canonical truth source.
- Map position, visual proximity, evolution stage, dependency, and sourcing decision are navigation judgments, not proof, isomorphism, natural law, causality, or transfer of Charter Gate responsibility.
- Multiscale Causal Fabric, Probabilistic System Dynamics, and Adaptive Relational Network are current modeling/projection capabilities, not new truth layers.
- Causal reachability is not actual causation; high probability is not strong causality; network adjacency, similarity, centrality, community, retrieval, self-report, or behavior change is not truth, value, causality, or internal learning proof.
- Future state-changing work must follow ITERATION.md: recover remote truth, prove the gap, set a claim ceiling, synchronize front-door/current-state surfaces, validate exact final HEAD, and write receipts.
- For the 0.4.0 Draft candidate, type writing material as external_input or ignition_increment and preserve source backlinks, version, claim ceiling and residue. Derived project output is reusable writing material but not independent evidence. Keep cognitive-level movement, unmapped differences, real/Charter costs and information-gain stopping; never turn the system map into a fixed article outline.
